summary: LakeShore Biopharma reports completion of its going-private merger under a November 4, 2025 agreement, amended April 29, 2026, with Oceanpine Merger Sub Inc. and parent Oceanpine Skyline Inc. Shareholders (except excluded and dissenting shares) receive US$0.066 per share in cash. The merger was approved at an EGM on June 19, 2026. The company will file Form 15 to suspend SEC reporting and expects FINRA to remove its OTC Pink tickers. Watch for deregistration timing and risk-arb on residual OTC trading after the close.
